human_editorial_change.original_paragraph: Your existing account opens the workspace where both views are available. Inspect them before deciding which language is usable, which claims need checking, and what should be rewritten.
human_editorial_change.reviewed_paragraph: Sign in to your workspace. If you already have a completed run, use its report and your brand's Knowledge page to check the draft. Otherwise, start with one real offer and request one email before reviewing it.
